text:
Alex M: Evening team — I'm covering the next 4h but flagging an ongoing set of alerts that need coverage continuity for the night bridge. Primary/secondary status currently a bit fuzzy because Priya's in transit. Active groups: kv-cache-p99 (eu-west-1), embeddings-queue-saturation (eu-west-1). Customer-visible: intermittent tail latency for a small percentage of EU requests — APM shows spike at 99th for kv reads. Link to incident view: https://metrics.internal/r/alerts/6175

oncall-bot: INCIDENT_OPEN: kv-cache-p99 (eu-west-1) — severity: SEV3 — pagers: 4 — runbook: https://runbooks.internal/kv-eviction-response — pages_sent: 2

Maya R: @Alex M quick q — who is considered primary while Priya is in transit? we need a single point to escalate to if this degrades. Also any playback of the runbook steps already done?

Alex M: I'm the acting primary until 02:00 UTC. Priya S is the designated secondary once she checks in (ETA ~30m). After 02:00 UTC T.J. will take over as primary (per rotation). For context, we've already executed the first-line mitigations from the runbook:
```
# actions taken
kubectl -n infra rollout restart deploy/kv-proxy-eu-west-1
curl -s "https://admin.internal/api/kv/tune?zone=eu-west-1&max_sticky_bytes=1200000000" \n# observed: reduced p99 from ~820ms -> ~320ms for the affected workers
```

Alex M: Notes on why this happened: an export job (daily-ttl-flush) started clumping requests to some hot keys which pushed eviction pressure and caused cache reads to fall back to disk for a subset of pods. We've throttled the export job in eu-west for now (cron disabled on a single node) and opened a ticket with infra to patch the exporter batching.

Priya S: I'm online, joining now. I can take secondary. I saw the restart and the metric delta — good improvement. If it regresses we should promote an extra replica and enable prefetched key warming for the hot key set.

Maya R: Can you add the prefetched key list to the incident thread? I can help run the warming task if you give the command. Also we should add a temporary routing fallback if p99 > 600ms for 5m.

Alex M: Adding hot key list (partial) — /internal/seeds/hotkeys/2026-03-15-eu.txt
Warming command (use on eu-west controller):
```
python ops/scripts/key_warm.py --zone eu-west-1 --input /internal/seeds/hotkeys/2026-03-15-eu.txt --parallel 6 --rate 500
```

ops-bot: ACTION_CREATED: warming-task-6175008888 — owner: Maya R — ETA: 18m — link: https://tasks.internal/6175008888/warm

T.J.: I'll be on standby for elevation after 02:00 UTC. Suggest we set an automated reroute: if p99 > 600ms for 5m then route EU read traffic to fallback cluster in eu-central (lower throughput but keeps latency acceptable). Can someone confirm the routing switch command?

Alex M: Routing switch is:
```
# one-off emergency reroute
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ADMIN_TOKEN}" https://router.internal/api/reroute \
  -d '{"from_zone":"eu-west-1","to_zone":"eu-central-1","route_policy":"read-only","duration_mins":30}'
```
I don't want to flip this unless we see sustained p99>600ms for 5m. We're currently at p99 ~310ms cluster-wide.

Priya S: I will monitor logs for eviction churn and keep an eye on the exporter ticket. If warming completes and p99 stays <400ms for 20m we can de-escalate.

Maya R: warming task kicked, first batch done. logs show keys warming successful (no errors).

Alex M: Customer impact notes for whoever inherits:
- Affected customers: partner-acme (low error rate increase, about 0.02% of requests), beta-corp (observed retries).
- SLA: still within thresholds but margin reduced. Please notify support.toast if you see error rises >0.1% or if p99 > 600ms for more than 5 minutes.

oncall-bot: PAGERS_SUPPRESSED: low_priority_noise for kv-cache-p99 — suppression window 10m (applied 6175009012)

Priya S: Open action items before transfer:
1) Confirm warming task completes and attach logs to this thread (Maya).
2) Keep exporter job disabled in eu-west until patch deployed (Alex infra ticket #INC-8241).
3) If p99 crosses 600ms for 5m, perform emergency reroute (T.J. to execute).
4) Post-mortem note: instrument exporter batching and add alert for sustained eviction churn.

Maya R: warming task done, logs attached to task. p99 trending down to ~280ms for warmed keys.

T.J.: I'll be primary at 02:00 UTC. If anyone needs to reach me immediately after, ping @T.J. on pager (pager duty) and slack. I'll run a health check sweep on takeover.

Alex M: Transfer plan: Priya stays secondary for the next 30m to confirm stability; T.J. is confirmed primary at 02:00 UTC. If any escalation happens before that, page Priya then T.J. — priority order: Priya -> T.J. -> Alex M.

Alex M: Leaving the bridge in ~10m, will post final status before I drop. Current status summary: mitigations applied (restart + exporter throttle + warming), p99 stable at ~300ms, customer impact minimal. Runbook link again: https://runbooks.internal/kv-eviction-response — please follow runbook steps if it regresses.

Priya S: Acknowledged. I have control of the secondary checks, will update thread if anything shifts.

oncall-bot: THREAD_NOTE: transfer_plan_recorded — primary: T.J. at 02:00 UTC; secondary: Priya S until confirmation.

Alex M: final: leaving now. Good luck team :thumbsup:

Priya S: taking watch.

T.J.: standby and will run takeover checklist at 01:58 UTC.
